response.rationale: Both answers denote the same room or fixture used for relieving oneself. “Toilet” is the ordinary Indonesian preference, while “tandas” is the ordinary Malaysian preference; this is a useful contrast without exclusive word ownership.
response.risk_rationale: Usage overlap in Malaysia may reduce the strength of the national preference slightly.
